content.query:
securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols/regulatorycomplianceassessments"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId ==  "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend failedResources = toint(properties.failedResources), passedResources = toint(properties.passedResources),skippedResources = toint(properties.skippedResources)
    | where failedResources + passedResources + skippedResources > 0
    | join kind = leftouter(
    securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/assessments") on subscriptionId, name
    | extend complianceState = properties.state
    | extend resourceSource = tolower(tostring(properties1.resourceDetails.Source))
    | extend recommendationId = id1
    | extend resourceId = trim(' ', tolower(tostring(case(resourceSource =~ 'azure', properties1.resourceDetails.Id,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'gcp', properties1.resourceDetails.GcpResourceId,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'aws', properties1.resourceDetails.AwsResourceId,
                                                        extract('^(.+)/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/.+$',1,recommendationId)))))
    | extend regexResourceId = extract_all(@"/providers/[^/]+(?:/([^/]+)/[^/]+(?:/[^/]+/[^/]+)?)?/([^/]+)/([^/]+)$", resourceId)[0]
    | extend resourceType = iff(regexResourceId[1] != "", regexResourceId[1], iff(regexResourceId[0] != "", regexResourceId[0], "subscriptions"))
    | extend resourceName = regexResourceId[2]
    | extend recommendationName = name
    | extend RecommendationName = properties1.displayName
    | extend description = properties1.metadata.description
    | extend remediationSteps = properties1.metadata.remediationDescription
    | extend severity = properties1.metadata.severity
    | extend state = properties1.status.code
    | extend notApplicableReason = properties1.status.cause
    | extend RecommendationLink = properties1.links.azurePortal
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | extend complianceControlId = extract(@"/regulatoryComplianceControls/([^/]*)", 1, id)
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId == "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend  controlName = tostring(properties.description)
    | project controlId = name, controlName
    | distinct  *) on $right.controlId == $left.complianceControlId
    | summarize Failed = countif(state == "Unhealthy"), Passed = countif(state == "Healthy"), Total = countif(state == "Unhealthy" or state == "Healthy") by tostring(RecommendationName), ControlID = controlId, recommendationName
    | extend PassedControls = (Passed/todouble(Total))*100
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols/regulatorycomplianceassessments"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId ==  "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend RecommendationName = tostring(properties.description)
    | extend RecommendationLink = tostring(properties.assessmentDetailsLink)
    | project RecommendationName, RecommendationLink) on RecommendationName  
    | distinct ControlID, RecommendationName, Total, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, RecommendationLink, recommendationName
   | distinct RecommendationName, Total, RecommendationLink, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, recommendationName
| where RecommendationName contains "vuln"
    | sort by Total desc

];
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Status=="Closed"
| mv-expand AlertIds
| extend SystemAlertId=strcat(AlertIds)
| join kind=inner (SecurityAlert | extend SystemAlertId=strcat(SystemAlertId)) on SystemAlertId
| summarize
    TruePositive = countif(Classification == "TruePositive"),
    BenignPositive = countif(Classification == "BenignPositive"),
    FalsePositive = countif(Classification == "FalsePositive"),
    Undetermined = countif(Classification == "Undetermined"),
    Total = countif(Classification == "TruePositive" or Classification == "BenignPositive" or Classification == "FalsePositive") by AlertName, ProviderName1
| extend EfficiencyRating = (TruePositive / todouble(Total)) * 100
| join kind=leftouter(SecurityProducts) on $left.ProviderName1 == $right.ProviderName
| project AlertName, EfficiencyRating, Portal, Product, Total, TruePositive, BenignPositive, FalsePositive, Undetermined
| sort by EfficiencyRating, Total desc

let RecommendationData = DeviceTvmSecureConfigurationAssessment | extend DiscoveredTimeUTC = TimeGenerated, RecommendationSeverity = iff(IsCompliant == 0, "High", "Low"), RecommendationDisplayName = ConfigurationId, AssessedResourceId = DeviceName, RecommendationState = iff(IsCompliant == 1, "Healthy", "Unhealthy");

    Failed = countif(RecommendationState == "Unhealthy"),

| sort by Total, Failed desc
| limit 250

## Implementation Guidance [Microsoft Technical Reference Guide for CMMC 2.0](https://aka.ms/cmmc/techrefguide)

content.query:
securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols/regulatorycomplianceassessments"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId ==  "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend failedResources = toint(properties.failedResources), passedResources = toint(properties.passedResources),skippedResources = toint(properties.skippedResources)
    | where failedResources + passedResources + skippedResources > 0
    | join kind = leftouter(
    securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/assessments") on subscriptionId, name
    | extend complianceState = properties.state
    | extend resourceSource = tolower(tostring(properties1.resourceDetails.Source))
    | extend recommendationId = id1
    | extend resourceId = trim(' ', tolower(tostring(case(resourceSource =~ 'azure', properties1.resourceDetails.Id,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'gcp', properties1.resourceDetails.GcpResourceId,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'aws', properties1.resourceDetails.AwsResourceId,
                                                        extract('^(.+)/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/.+$',1,recommendationId)))))
    | extend regexResourceId = extract_all(@"/providers/[^/]+(?:/([^/]+)/[^/]+(?:/[^/]+/[^/]+)?)?/([^/]+)/([^/]+)$", resourceId)[0]
    | extend resourceType = iff(regexResourceId[1] != "", regexResourceId[1], iff(regexResourceId[0] != "", regexResourceId[0], "subscriptions"))
    | extend resourceName = regexResourceId[2]
    | extend recommendationName = name
    | extend RecommendationName = properties1.displayName
    | extend description = properties1.metadata.description
    | extend remediationSteps = properties1.metadata.remediationDescription
    | extend severity = properties1.metadata.severity
    | extend state = properties1.status.code
    | extend notApplicableReason = properties1.status.cause
    | extend RecommendationLink = properties1.links.azurePortal
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | extend complianceControlId = extract(@"/regulatoryComplianceControls/([^/]*)", 1, id)
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId == "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend  controlName = tostring(properties.description)
    | project controlId = name, controlName
    | distinct  *) on $right.controlId == $left.complianceControlId
    | summarize Failed = countif(state == "Unhealthy"), Passed = countif(state == "Healthy"), Total = countif(state == "Unhealthy" or state == "Healthy") by tostring(RecommendationName), ControlID = controlId, recommendationName
    | extend PassedControls = (Passed/todouble(Total))*100
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols/regulatorycomplianceassessments"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId ==  "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend RecommendationName = tostring(properties.description)
    | extend RecommendationLink = tostring(properties.assessmentDetailsLink)
    | project RecommendationName, RecommendationLink) on RecommendationName  
    | distinct ControlID, RecommendationName, Total, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, RecommendationLink, recommendationName
   | distinct RecommendationName, Total, RecommendationLink, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, recommendationName
| where RecommendationName contains "network" or RecommendationName contains "transit" or RecommendationName contains "http" or RecommendationName contains "web" or RecommendationName contains "port" or RecommendationName contains "internet" or RecommendationName contains "comm" or RecommendationName contains "private" or RecommendationName contains "firewall" 
    | sort by Total, Passed desc
content.title: Review Microsoft Defender for Cloud Recommendations

| render timechart

    | extend resourceId = trim(' ', tolower(tostring(case(resourceSource =~ 'azure', properties1.resourceDetails.Id,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'gcp', properties1.resourceDetails.GcpResourceId,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'aws', properties1.resourceDetails.AwsResourceId,
                                                        extract('^(.+)/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/.+$',1,recommendationId)))))
    | extend regexResourceId = extract_all(@"/providers/[^/]+(?:/([^/]+)/[^/]+(?:/[^/]+/[^/]+)?)?/([^/]+)/([^/]+)$", resourceId)[0]
    | extend resourceType = iff(regexResourceId[1] != "", regexResourceId[1], iff(regexResourceId[0] != "", regexResourceId[0], "subscriptions"))
    | extend resourceName = regexResourceId[2]
    | extend recommendationName = name
    | extend RecommendationName = properties1.displayName
    | extend description = properties1.metadata.description
    | extend remediationSteps = properties1.metadata.remediationDescription
    | extend severity = properties1.metadata.severity
    | extend state = properties1.status.code
    | extend notApplicableReason = properties1.status.cause
    | extend RecommendationLink = properties1.links.azurePortal
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | extend complianceControlId = extract(@"/regulatoryComplianceControls/([^/]*)", 1, id)
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId == "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend  controlName = tostring(properties.description)
    | project controlId = name, controlName
    | distinct  *) on $right.controlId == $left.complianceControlId
    | summarize Failed = countif(state == "Unhealthy"), Passed = countif(state == "Healthy"), Total = countif(state == "Unhealthy" or state == "Healthy") by tostring(RecommendationName), ControlID = controlId, recommendationName
    | extend PassedControls = (Passed/todouble(Total))*100
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols/regulatorycomplianceassessments"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId ==  "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend RecommendationName = tostring(properties.description)
    | extend RecommendationLink = tostring(properties.assessmentDetailsLink)
    | project RecommendationName, RecommendationLink) on RecommendationName  
    | distinct ControlID, RecommendationName, Total, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, RecommendationLink, recommendationName
   | distinct RecommendationName, Total, RecommendationLink, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, recommendationName
| where RecommendationName contains "defender"
    | sort by Total, Passed desc

let SigninBehavior = SigninLogs | project TimeGenerated, ActionType = "Sign-in", ActivityType = "LogOn", SourceRecordId = Id, UserName = UserDisplayName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights = pack("NewAccount", false, "DormantAccount", false, "AccountUPN", UserPrincipalName, "IsNewAccount", false, "BlastRadius", "Low"), ActivityInsights = pack("FirstTimeUserAccessedResource", false, "ResourceUncommonlyAccessedAmongPeers", false, "FirstTimeUserUsedApp", false, "AppUncommonlyUsedAmongPeers", false, "ActionUncommonlyPerformedByUser", false, "ActionUncommonlyPerformedAmongPeers", false, "FirstTimeUserLoggedOnFromCountry", false, "CountryUncommonlyConnectedFromAmongPeers", false), ResourceDisplayName, AppDisplayName, SourceIPAddress = IPAddress, SourceIPLocation = Location, SourceDevice = tostring(DeviceDetail.displayName), DevicesInsights = pack("ThreatIntelIndicatorType", ""), InvestigationPriority = 0;
let AnomalousSigninActivity = SigninBehavior
    | where ActionType == "Sign-in"
    | where (UsersInsights.NewAccount == True or UsersInsights.DormantAccount == True) and (
        ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserAccessedResource == True and ActivityInsights.ResourceUncommonlyAccessedAmongPeers == True
        or ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserUsedApp == True and ActivityInsights.AppUncommonlyUsedAmongPeers == False)
    | join (
        SigninLogs | where Status.errorCode == 0 or Status.errorCode == 0 and RiskDetail != "none"
        )
        on $left.SourceRecordId == $right.Id
    | extend UserPrincipalName = iff(UserPrincipalName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserPrincipalName),
        UserName = iff(UserName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserName)
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Successful Logon",
        Tactic = "Persistence",
        Technique = "Valid Accounts",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Successful Sign-in with one or more of the following indications: sign by new or recently dormant accounts and sign in with resource for the first time (while none of their peers did) or to an app for the first time (while none of their peers did) or performed by a user with Risk indicaiton from AAD"
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, ResourceDisplayName, AppDisplayName, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; 
let critical = dynamic(['9b895d92-2cd3-44c7-9d02-a6ac2d5ea5c3', 'c4e39bd9-1100-46d3-8c65-fb160da0071f', '158c047a-c907-4556-b7ef-446551a6b5f7', '62e90394-69f5-4237-9190-012177145e10', 'd29b2b05-8046-44ba-8758-1e26182fcf32', '729827e3-9c14-49f7-bb1b-9608f156bbb8', '966707d0-3269-4727-9be2-8c3a10f19b9d', '194ae4cb-b126-40b2-bd5b-6091b380977d', 'fe930be7-5e62-47db-91af-98c3a49a38b1']);
let high = dynamic(['cf1c38e5-3621-4004-a7cb-879624dced7c', '7495fdc4-34c4-4d15-a289-98788ce399fd', 'aaf43236-0c0d-4d5f-883a-6955382ac081', '3edaf663-341e-4475-9f94-5c398ef6c070', '7698a772-787b-4ac8-901f-60d6b08affd2', 'b1be1c3e-b65d-4f19-8427-f6fa0d97feb9', '9f06204d-73c1-4d4c-880a-6edb90606fd8', '29232cdf-9323-42fd-ade2-1d097af3e4de', 'be2f45a1-457d-42af-a067-6ec1fa63bc45', '7be44c8a-adaf-4e2a-84d6-ab2649e08a13', 'e8611ab8-c189-46e8-94e1-60213ab1f814']);//witdstomstl
let AnomalousRoleAssignment = AuditLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(28d)
    | where OperationName == "Add member to role"
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend RoleId = tostring(TargetResources.modifiedProperties[0].newValue)
    | where isnotempty(RoleId) and RoleId in (critical, high)
    | extend RoleName = tostring(TargetResources.modifiedProperties[1].newValue)
    | where isnotempty(RoleName)
    | extend TargetId = tostring(TargetResources.id)
    | extend Target = tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName)
    | join kind=inner (
        SigninBehavior
        | where ActionType == "Add member to role"
        | where UsersInsights.BlasrRadius == "High" or ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserPerformedAction == true
        )
        on $left.Id == $right.SourceRecordId
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Role Assignemt",
        Tactic = "Persistence",
        Technique = "Account Manipulation",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Adversaries may manipulate accounts to maintain access to victim systems. These actions include adding new accounts to high privilleged groups. Dragonfly 2.0, for example, added newly created accounts to the administrators group to maintain elevated access.  The query below generates an output of all high Blast Radius users performing Add member to priveleged role, or ones that add users for the first time."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["TargetUser"]=Target, RoleName, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; let LogOns=materialize(
    SigninBehavior
    | where ActivityType == "LogOn");
let AnomalousResourceAccess = LogOns
    | where ActionType == "ResourceAccess"
    | where ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserLoggedOnToDevice == true
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Resource Access",
        Tactic = "Lateral Movement",
        Technique = "",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Adversary may be trying to move through the environment. APT29 and APT32, for example, has used PtH & PtT techniques to lateral move around the network. The query below generates an output of all users performing an resource access (4624:3) to devices for the first time."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; 
let AnomalousRDPActivity = LogOns
    | where ActionType == "RemoteInteractiveLogon"
    | where ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserLoggedOnToDevice == true
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous RDP Activity",
        Tactic = "Lateral Movement",
        Technique = "",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to log into a computer using the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user. FIN10, for example, has used RDP to move laterally to systems in the victim environment. The query below generates an output of all users performing a remote interactive logon (4624:10) to a device for the first time."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; 
let AnomalousLogintoDevices = LogOns
    | where ActionType == "InteractiveLogon"
    | where ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserLoggedOnToDevice == true
    | where UsersInsights.DormantAccount == true or DevicesInsights.LocalAdmin == true
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Login To Devices",
        Tactic = "Privilege Escalation",
        Technique = "Valid Accounts",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Adversaries may steal the credentials of a specific user or service account using Credential Access techniques or capture credentials earlier in their reconnaissance process through social engineering for means of gaining Initial Access. APT33, for example, has used valid accounts for initial access and privilege escalation. The query below generates an output of all administator users performing an interactive logon (4624:2) to a device for the first time."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; 
let AnomalousPasswordReset = SigninBehavior
    | where ActionType == "Reset user password"
    | where ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserPerformedAction == "True"
    | join (
        AuditLogs
        | where OperationName == "Reset user password"
        )
        on $left.SourceRecordId == $right.Id
    | mv-expand TargetResources
    | extend Target =  iff(tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName) contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(TargetResources.userPrincipalName, "#")[0])), TargetResources.userPrincipalName), tostring(TargetResources.userPrincipalName)
    | extend UserPrincipalName = iff(UserPrincipalName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserPrincipalName),
        UserName = iff(UserName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserName)
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Password Reset",
        Tactic = "Impact",
        Technique = "Account Access Removal",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Adversaries may interrupt availability of system and network resources by inhibiting access to accounts utilized by legitimate users. Accounts may be deleted, locked, or manipulated (ex: changed credentials) to remove access to accounts. LockerGoga, for example, has been observed changing account passwords and logging off current users. The query below generates an output of all users performing Reset user password for the first time."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["TargetUser"]=Target, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority
    | sort by TimeGenerated desc;
let AnomalousGeoLocationLogon = SigninBehavior
    | where ActionType == "Sign-in"
    | where ActivityInsights.FirstTimeUserConnectedFromCountry == True and (ActivityInsights.FirstTimeConnectionFromCountryObservedInTenant == True or ActivityInsights.CountryUncommonlyConnectedFromAmongPeers == True)
    | join (
        SigninLogs
        )
        on $left.SourceRecordId == $right.Id
    | extend UserPrincipalName = iff(UserPrincipalName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserPrincipalName),
        UserName = iff(UserName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserName)
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Successful Logon",
        Tactic = "Initial Access",
        Technique = "Valid Accounts",
        SubTechnique = "",
        Description = "Adversaries may steal the credentials of a specific user or service account using Credential Access techniques or capture credentials earlier in their reconnaissance process through social engineering for means of gaining Initial Access. APT33, for example, has used valid accounts for initial access. The query below generates an output of successful Sign-in performed by a user from a new geo location he has never connected from before, and none of his peers as well."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, ResourceDisplayName, AppDisplayName, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; 
let AnomalousFailedLogon = SigninBehavior
    | where ActivityType == "LogOn"
    | where UsersInsights.BlastRadius == "High"
    | join (
        SigninLogs  
        | where Status.errorCode == 50126
        )
        on $left.SourceRecordId == $right.Id
    | extend UserPrincipalName = iff(UserPrincipalName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserPrincipalName),
        UserName = iff(UserName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserName)
    | extend AnomalyName = "Anomalous Failed Logon",
        Tactic = "Credential Access",
        Technique = "Brute Force",
        SubTechnique = "Password Guessing",
        Description = "Adversaries with no prior knowledge of legitimate credentials within the system or environment may guess passwords to attempt access to accounts. Emotet, for example, has been observed using a hard coded list of passwords to brute force user accounts. The query below generates an output of all users with 'High' BlastRadius that perform failed Sign-in:Invalid username or password."
    | project TimeGenerated, AnomalyName, Tactic, Technique, SubTechnique, Description, UserName, UserPrincipalName, UsersInsights, ActivityType, ActionType, ["Evidence"]=ActivityInsights, ResourceDisplayName, AppDisplayName, SourceIPAddress, SourceIPLocation, SourceDevice, DevicesInsights, ["Anomaly Score"]=InvestigationPriority; 
let AnomalousAADAccountManipulation = AuditLogs
    | where OperationName == "Update user"
    | mv-expand AdditionalDetails

    | extend UserPrincipalName = iff(UserPrincipalName contains "#EXT#", replace("_", "@", tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "#")[0])), UserPrincipalName),

    | project Name=tolower(UserName), UPN=tolower(UserPrincipalName), AadUserId=UsersInsights_AccountObjectId, Sid=UsersInsights_OnPremSid, AnomalyCount

    | summarize hint.strategy = shuffle IncidentCount=sum(IncidentCount), AlertCount=sum(AlertCount), AnomalyCount=sum(AnomalyCount), UPNAnchor=anyif(UPNAnchor, isempty(UPNAnchor) == false), AadAnchor=anyif(AadAnchor, isempty(AadAnchor) == false), SidAnchor=anyif(SidAnchor, isempty(SidAnchor) == false), any(any_any_Title, any_any_Severity, any_any_StartTime, any_any_IncidentNumber, any_any_IncidentUrl) by NameAnchor

let LastObserved = SigninLogs
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by UserPrincipalName
| project UserPrincipalName, LastSignIn=TimeGenerated;
SigninLogs
| extend UserProfile = strcat("https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_AAD_IAM/UserDetailsMenuBlade/Profile/userId/", UserId)
| where ResultType == 0
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, UserProfile, UserId
| join (LastObserved) on UserPrincipalName
| project UserPrincipalName, SignInCount=count_, UserProfile, LastSignIn, UserId
| sort by SignInCount desc
| limit 250

AuditLogs
| extend UserPrincipalName = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend UserProfile = strcat("https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_AAD_IAM/UserDetailsMenuBlade/Profile/userId/",UserPrincipalName)
| summarize Runs = count(), Success = countif(Result == 'success'), Fails = countif(Result != 'success') by UserPrincipalName, OperationName, UserProfile // Summarize the total, successful and failed operations by name
| extend SuccessRate = (Success * 100 / Runs) // Calculate the percentage of successful operations against the total
| join (SigninLogs | project UserPrincipalName, UserId) on UserPrincipalName
| summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, UserProfile, OperationName, UserId

    | extend resourceSource = tolower(tostring(properties1.resourceDetails.Source))
    | extend recommendationId = id1
    | extend resourceId = trim(' ', tolower(tostring(case(resourceSource =~ 'azure', properties1.resourceDetails.Id,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'gcp', properties1.resourceDetails.GcpResourceId,
                                                        resourceSource =~ 'aws', properties1.resourceDetails.AwsResourceId,
                                                        extract('^(.+)/providers/Microsoft.Security/assessments/.+$',1,recommendationId)))))
    | extend regexResourceId = extract_all(@"/providers/[^/]+(?:/([^/]+)/[^/]+(?:/[^/]+/[^/]+)?)?/([^/]+)/([^/]+)$", resourceId)[0]
    | extend resourceType = iff(regexResourceId[1] != "", regexResourceId[1], iff(regexResourceId[0] != "", regexResourceId[0], "subscriptions"))
    | extend resourceName = regexResourceId[2]
    | extend recommendationName = name
    | extend RecommendationName = properties1.displayName
    | extend description = properties1.metadata.description
    | extend remediationSteps = properties1.metadata.remediationDescription
    | extend severity = properties1.metadata.severity
    | extend state = properties1.status.code
    | extend notApplicableReason = properties1.status.cause
    | extend RecommendationLink = properties1.links.azurePortal
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | extend complianceControlId = extract(@"/regulatoryComplianceControls/([^/]*)", 1, id)
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId == "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend  controlName = tostring(properties.description)
    | project controlId = name, controlName
    | distinct  *) on $right.controlId == $left.complianceControlId
    | summarize Failed = countif(state == "Unhealthy"), Passed = countif(state == "Healthy"), Total = countif(state == "Unhealthy" or state == "Healthy") by tostring(RecommendationName), ControlID = controlId, recommendationName
    | extend PassedControls = (Passed/todouble(Total))*100
    | join kind = leftouter (securityresources
    | where type == "microsoft.security/regulatorycompliancestandards/regulatorycompliancecontrols/regulatorycomplianceassessments"
    | extend complianceStandardId = replace( "-", " ", extract(@'/regulatoryComplianceStandards/([^/]*)', 1, id))
    | where complianceStandardId ==  "NIST SP 800 171 R2"
    | extend RecommendationName = tostring(properties.description)
    | extend RecommendationLink = tostring(properties.assessmentDetailsLink)
    | project RecommendationName, RecommendationLink) on RecommendationName  
    | distinct ControlID, RecommendationName, Total, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, RecommendationLink, recommendationName
   | distinct RecommendationName, Total, RecommendationLink, PassedControls, Passed, Failed, recommendationName
| where RecommendationName contains "defender"
    | sort by Total, Passed desc

let IncidentTrending = SecurityIncident 
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by IncidentNumber 
| extend IncidentType=Title
| make-series Trend = dcount(IncidentNumber) default = 0 on TimeGenerated in range({TimeRange:start}, {TimeRange:end}, {TimeRange:grain}) by IncidentType;
SecurityIncident
| extend Tactics = tostring(parse_json(tostring(AdditionalData.tactics)))
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| parse IncidentUrl with * '/#asset/Microsoft_Azure_Security_Insights/Incident' IncidentBlade
| extend SeverityRank=iff(Severity == "High", 3, iff(Severity == "Medium", 2, iff(Severity == "Low", 1, iff(Severity == "Informational", 0, 0))))
| sort by SeverityRank, TimeGenerated desc
| summarize count() by IncidentType=Title, Severity
| join kind=inner(IncidentTrending) on IncidentType
| sort by count_ desc
| project IncidentType, Severity, count_, Trend
| limit 250
